component.name: MovieScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.playlistId = "" m.top.onMovieSelect = invalid m.top.onBack = false m.movieGrid = m.top.findNode("movieGrid") m.movieGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onGridItemSelected") end sub
sub loadMovies(playlistId as string) m.top.playlistId = playlistId result = syncPlaylists(0) if result.ok items = [] for each playlist in result.data.playlists if playlist.id = playlistId or playlistId = "" for each movie in playlist.movies ? [] items.push({ id: movie.id, title: movie.title, poster: movie.posterUrl, description: movie.description, streamUrl: movie.streamUrl }) end for end if end for m.movieGrid.content = buildGridContent(items) end if end sub
sub onGridItemSelected() idx = m.movieGrid.itemSelected if idx >= 0 item = m.movieGrid.content.getChild(idx) m.top.onMovieSelect = { title: item.title, streamUrl: item.streamUrl } end if end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) if key = 283 m.top.onBack = true end if end sub
